description: This file defines the ProjectAdminUserRole class, which inherits from AbstractUserRole and manages user role permissions specific to project administration within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods to retrieve accessible entity IDs such as employees, projects, and customers based on the user's permissions.

classes.name: ProjectAdminUserRole
classes.description: A class representing a user role with administrative privileges over projects, providing methods to retrieve accessible entities based on permissions.

methods.name: getAccessibleIdsForEntity
methods.description: Determines accessible entity IDs based on entity type and permissions.

methods.name: getAccessibleEmployeeIds
methods.description: Retrieves employee IDs accessible to the user if permission conditions are met.

methods.name: getAccessibleProjectIds
methods.description: Retrieves project IDs accessible to the user based on their role.

methods.name: getAccessibleCustomerIds
methods.description: Retrieves customer IDs accessible to the user based on their role.
